content.value: The front end of a radio receiver, having a bandwidth of 10 MHz and operating at a temperature of $2 7 \cdot ^ { 0 } \mathrm { C } ,$ consists of an amplifier and mixer. The amplifier has a gain of 10, a 600 Ω input resistor, a 1600 Ω equivalent noise resistançe and a 27 KΩ output resistor. For the mixer, these values are 25 KΩ, 81 KΩ, 10 KΩ and 1MΩ, respectively.
If it is driven by a generator whose output impedance is 50 Ω, calculate the noise figure of the radio receiver.
